output.murderer: Dr Casimir Vauthier, the family physician
output.reasoning: Regulator matched the temple at 10:00, so it was right; its stop at 10:05 was staged. The hall clock struck ten when the regulator read 9:48, so it was 12 min fast and struck eleven at 10:48 true. The kitchen clock read 11:13 then, so it was 25 min fast (the master changed it that afternoon). That puts the piano at 10:33–10:46 true, and Lina in the kitchen with Rosa from 10:22. Félix's watch was 20 min slow: steps up 10:35, thump and repeater 10:38, steps down 10:41. Girard's watch was 4 min slow (piano start, hall-clock face 11:02 at 10:50, return just after the strike), so his bells were also at 10:38 and he was in the street 10:25–10:50. Odile was at the piano. Vauthier was away from the salon for the whole 10:33–10:46 piano spell, which covers the trip up and down. He lied that he left at 'quarter to eleven' by his 2-min-fast watch (10:43 true), and his cigar-case story contradicts Odile's account.
